g.text: Annual education spending per student (rupees, log scale)
The top tenth of students spend 31 times what the bottom tenth spend
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files.
Sample: 1464 students in rural Balochistan with spending > 0; 1463 plotted (one below Rs 100 excluded).
Weighted by hhweight; bins are 0.1 log10 units across Rs 100-1,000,000.
